items.description: Hidden resolver item. Exchange recipe 4100 (open a Deep Relic Cache with a Cache Key) targets this itemdefid as its Steam-side output so Valve rolls the reward server-side. Weights must mirror server/lootTables.js DEEP_RELIC_CACHE_DROP_TABLE exactly, since disclosed odds must equal actual odds. Verify the correct Steamworks item type for exchange-triggered generators before publishing — this repo could not confirm that against live Steamworks admin.
